[calm] That's {NAME} out there, the big one the rest follow.
[calm] {NAME}'s pack is on the move again, keep the animals close.
[threat] Watch {NAME}, the others go wherever it goes.
[threat] {NAME}'s leading them in, everyone get inside.
[child] Is that {NAME}, the big {KIND} everyone talks about?
There goes {NAME}, with its pack behind it.
Look at the size of {NAME} next to the others.

warm.li: [calm] {NAME} looks after its own, you can see it.

blunt.li: {NAME}'s out there, so nobody goes past the fields alone.

cheerful.li: [calm] {NAME} keeps a fine pack, I'll give it that.

gloomy.li: {NAME} will have one of us someday if we're not careful.

cold.li: Bring {NAME} down and the rest will run, remember that.

plain.li: [killed] I'll bring {X_nameDef} down for {VICTIM}, whatever it takes.
[maimed] {X_nameDef} won't walk away from what it did to {VICTIM}.
[partner] For {VICTIM}, I'll find {X_nameDef} and finish it.
[kin,killed] {X_nameDef} took {VICTIM} from us, and I'll take it from the world.
[friend] {VICTIM} would do it for me, so I'll see {X_nameDef} dead.
Next time {X_nameDef} shows itself, I'll be waiting.

warm.li: [killed] I'm doing this for {VICTIM}, not for me.

blunt.li: {X_nameDef} is mine, nobody else touches it.

gloomy.li: [killed] It won't bring {VICTIM} back, but {X_nameDef} is going down.

cold.li: {X_nameDef} has a debt, and I mean to collect it.

plain.li: Look at all those {KIND}, the ground's shaking with them.
[great] The great herd's come through again, like the old stories say.
[great] I've never seen so many {KIND} in one place.
Stop a moment, the {KIND} are going by.
[child] There are so many of them, can we count them?
[child] Look, the {KIND} are walking right past us.

warm.li: They're beautiful, all of them together like that.

blunt.li: Nobody shoot near them unless you want a stampede.

cheerful.li: Best thing I've seen all season, those {KIND}.

gloomy.li: One shot and they'd run us all down, you know.

cold.li: Mark which way they go, we'll want that next year.

plain.li: And down came the beast the whole region feared.
Sing it again, the part where it fell.
They'll be singing this one in every town by spring.
I'll never forget the sound it made coming down.
There's a verse for the tracks, a verse for the hunt, and one for the end.
To the hunter, and to the beast that made them famous.

warm.li: Here's to it, it was a grand old beast.

blunt.li: Hit it in the right place and even a legend falls.

cheerful.li: Louder, they can't hear us in the next valley.

gloomy.li: Sad, in a way, there won't be another like it.

cold.li: A good song, and a good hide besides.

plain.li: I brought down {NAME} today, the {KIND} the whole pack ran behind. The rest scattered the moment it fell.
The pack's alpha is dead, and I'm the one who did it. I keep thinking about the way the others ran.

warm.li: I took no joy in killing {NAME}. But the pack is gone from our land, and that's worth something.

blunt.li: {NAME} is dead. Pack's gone. Good day's work.

gloomy.li: I killed {NAME}. Another pack will come, with another leader. They always do.

cold.li: Removed the alpha. The pack lost its nerve, as expected.

plain.li: [killed] I swore today that I'll bring down {X_nameDef} for what it did to {VICTIM}. I said it out loud, so now I have to.
[maimed] {VICTIM} will carry what {X_nameDef} did for the rest of their days. I've sworn that the beast won't.
I've made a promise I mean to keep: {X_nameDef} doesn't get to walk away.

warm.li: [killed] I keep thinking about {VICTIM}. Swearing to bring {X_nameDef} down is the only thing that's helped.

gloomy.li: Nothing I do to {X_nameDef} will undo it. I swore anyway.

cold.li: I have sworn to kill {X_nameDef}. It is a simple enough task.

plain.li: [kept] I kept my word. {NAME} is dead, and I was the one who did it. I said {VICTIM}'s name when it fell.
[others] {NAME} is dead, though not by my hand. I thought I'd mind more. Mostly I'm just glad.
[tamed] The colony tamed {NAME}. The beast I swore to kill sleeps in our barn now, and I don't know what to do with that.
[vanished] Nobody has seen {NAME} in so long that I think it's gone for good. My oath goes with it, I suppose.

warm.li: [kept] It's done. I hope {VICTIM} would have wanted it this way.

gloomy.li: [others] Someone else got to {NAME} first. It's over, and somehow it doesn't feel like it.

plain.li: I brought down {NAME} today. Every town in the region has a story about that beast, and now they'll have one about me.
My hands are still shaking. {NAME} is dead, and I did it.

warm.li: {NAME} was magnificent. I'm proud, and a little sorry, both at once.

blunt.li: Brought down {NAME}. Biggest thing I've ever hunted.

gloomy.li: There won't be another {NAME}. I'm the one who made sure of that.

cold.li: {NAME} is dead. The stories made it bigger than it was, but not by much.

plain.li: {NAME} let me come close today, and then it let me lead it. I still can't believe it.
Everyone wanted {NAME} dead. It's ours now, and it eats out of my hand.

warm.li: {NAME} is gentle with me. I don't think anyone would believe how gentle.

gloomy.li: {NAME} is ours now. I hope we deserve it.

cold.li: {NAME} has accepted me. A useful animal, and a famous one.
